# n8n_execution (Data Source)

Fetches a single n8n execution by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Execution identifier

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the execution was created
- `finished` (Boolean) Whether the execution has finished
- `mode` (String) Execution mode (e.g. manual, trigger, webhook)
- `started_at` (String) Timestamp when the execution started
- `status` (String) Execution status (e.g. success, error, running, waiting)
- `stopped_at` (String) Timestamp when the execution stopped
- `workflow_id` (String) Workflow identifier associated with this execution
